Browse a directory in a browser

Usage:
  ycy fs [directory] [flags]

Flags:
      --account stringArray        Account in username:password form (repeatable)
  -a, --address string             Address to bind (default "0.0.0.0")
      --chunked-upload             Enable retryable large-file uploads
  -h, --help                       help for fs
  -m, --manage                     Enable filesystem management
  -p, --port string                Port to serve on (default "1204")
      --safe-html                  Serve HTML and XHTML originals as sandboxed downloads
      --session-dir string         Directory for Go-owned login sessions
      --session-idle-days string   Session idle lifetime in days
      --upload-chunk-size string   Chunk size in MiB (4-16)

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics
